title: Review: Building a More Sustainable City

review_words.key_point_zh: float an idea 表示“提出想法试探反应”，与 drift 的无目的漂流不同。
review_words.example: The mayor floated the idea of a car-free city centre.
review_words.translation_zh: 市长提出了市中心无车化的想法以试探反应。
review_words.note_zh: float an idea 常用于政治或商业语境，表示试探性提出。

review_words.meaning_zh: 可持续的；能长期维持的
review_words.key_point_zh: 常搭配 sustainable development / growth / transport，强调长期维持且不破坏环境。
review_words.example: The report asks whether the city's rapid expansion is environmentally sustainable.
review_words.translation_zh: 报告质疑这座城市的快速扩张在环境上是否可持续。
review_words.note_zh: sustainable 可修饰发展、增长、交通等，也可表示“能长期维持的”。

review_words.key_point_zh: contribute to 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，表示“促成、导致”。
review_words.example: Lack of public transport can contribute to higher car use.
review_words.translation_zh: 公共交通不足会促使更多人使用汽车。
review_words.note_zh: contribute to + 名词/动名词；不要漏掉 to。

review_words.key_point_zh: a significant increase/decrease 是写作数据描述的常用搭配，强调变化值得注意。
review_words.example: The city recorded a significant drop in carbon emissions last year.
review_words.translation_zh: 该市去年碳排放显著下降。
review_words.note_zh: significant 修饰 drop，表示降幅显著；写作中可替换 noticeable。

review_words.key_point_zh: adapt to 表示适应新环境；注意与 adopt（采纳、收养）形近。
review_words.example: Residents are adapting to the new recycling rules.
review_words.translation_zh: 居民正在适应新的回收规定。
review_words.note_zh: adapt to 后接环境、变化等；adapt something for 表示“为……改编”。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you read the city's new climate plan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes. It floats the idea of a congestion charge, but nothing is decided yet.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That could contribute to cleaner air, though some drivers will find it hard to adapt.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. The report says the current level of car use isn't sustainable.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It also mentions a significant increase in cycling since last year.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's encouraging. But the plan needs better public transport, not just charges.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If buses are reliable, more people will adapt quickly.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's see whether the council turns the proposal into a real policy.

quiz.question: Which word is closest in meaning to 'sustainable' in the phrase 'sustainable growth'?
quiz.explanation_zh: viable 强调在现实条件下能持续运作；sustainable 更强调长期维持、不破坏环境。temporary 和 sudden 都与“可持续”相反。

quiz.question: Which sentence uses the correct collocation?
options: Poor waste management contributes to environmental damage.
Poor waste management contributes environmental damage.
Poor waste management contributes for environmental damage.
Poor waste management contributes with environmental damage.
quiz.explanation_zh: contribute to 是固定搭配，to 是介词，后面接名词或动名词。其他选项的介词搭配都不正确。

quiz.question: The city had to ___ its transport plan to meet new emissions targets.
quiz.explanation_zh: adapt 表示“调整、使适应”，符合“修改交通方案以达标”的语境。adopt 是“采纳、收养”，与句意不符；float 和 contribute 也不能这样使用。
